;;;132    #if SENSOR_TYPE_DIFF_AMP_ENABLE
;;;133        // ===== 差分放大器模式 =====
;;;134        // 差分放大器通常只有微小失调，零点近似0。但为了支持校准，依然使用 ZeroOffset
;;;135        int32_t s32ZeroOffset = pstcDev->stcCalibration.s32ZeroOffsetMv;

;;;143        int32_t s32Diff = (int32_t)u16AdcVoltageMv - s32ZeroOffset;
;;;144    
;;;145        // 转换为 mA: V_diff / Sensitivity (V/A) * 1000
;;;146        // Sensitivity 单位是 mV/A，所以直接 s32Diff / s32Sensitivity * 1000 单位是 mA
;;;147        // 但更好的方式是： s32Diff(mV) / (Sensitivity_mV_per_A) = A

;;;150            s32CurrentMa = (int32_t)(((int64_t)s32Diff * 1000) / s32Sensitivity);

;;;157            s32ZeroOffset = 0;
;;;158        }
;;;159        
;;;160        int32_t s32Diff = (int32_t)u16AdcVoltageMv - s32ZeroTheory - s32ZeroOffset;
;;;161        
;;;162        // 转换为 mA
;;;163        if (s32Sensitivity != 0) {
;;;164            int64_t s64Temp = (int64_t)s32Diff * 1000;
;;;165            s32CurrentMa = (int32_t)(s64Temp / s32Sensitivity);
;;;166        }
;;;167    #endif
;;;168    
;;;169        // 灵敏度微调
;;;170        if (pstcDev->stcCalibration.s16SensitivityScale != 0 && 
;;;171            pstcDev->stcCalibration.s16SensitivityScale != 100) {
;;;172            s32CurrentMa = (s32CurrentMa * pstcDev->stcCalibration.s16SensitivityScale) / 100;
;;;173        }
;;;174        
;;;175        return s32CurrentMa;
;;;176    }
